title: At the gym
instructions: Yeni bir üye spor salonunda antrenörle konuşuyor. Hedefini, programını ve tavsiyeleri takip et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Hi, Sara. Welcome to the gym. What would you like to do here?

script.speaker: b
script.text: I want to get fitter. I get tired very quickly when I walk up stairs.

script.speaker: a
script.text: OK. How often can you come?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Three times a week, maybe. I work long hours.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Three times is great. Let's start with thirty minutes on the bike and some easy exercises.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Should I do it every day?

script.speaker: a
script.text: No, your body needs to rest. Have a day off between each visit.

questions.prompt: Why does Sara want to go to the gym?

questions.feedback: Bisiklette otuz dakika ve kolay egzersizlerle başlayacak.
questions.evidence: Let's start with thirty minutes on the bike

questions.prompt: What does the trainer say about exercising every day?
options: She should do it twice a day.
